title: Colliders not overlapping but colliding
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in all versions i tried (4.3, 4.2.2, and the newest beta release)

### System information

Godot v4.2.2.stable - Linux Mint 22.1 (Xia) - X11 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 550.120) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9700F CPU @ 3.00GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

I have following problem:

I have an area3d that detects collision (mask 1).
I have a characterbody3d that can cause the collisions (layer 1)
both have just the basic box collider and are placed at the default position (0,0,0)

now i do the following:
i start the scene. the collision gets detected correctly.
then i change it, so the character body sets its x position to 10 in the _ready function, and start the scene. the collision still gets detected somehow. if i print out the positions and collider sizes in on_body_entered, i clearly see that they shouldn't collide.

here's the console output when i run my scene:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/af00f3a8-e2a8-482c-b1bf-6d500a6c3997)

If i change the type of the characterbody3d to rigidbody3d, it doesnt collide and behaves like i'd expect it to. 

### Steps to reproduce

Here's an image of my scene tree:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/34b2135c-932f-4a1a-aa4d-309b71bc8bc6)

here's the script i have assigned to the scenes root node:
```gdscript
extends Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	$CharacterBody3D.position.x = 10

func _on_body_entered(body: Node3D) -> void:
	print("collision detected")
	
	print("global x pos of other: ",body.global_position.x)
	print("global x pos of self: ",$Area3D.global_position.x)
	
	print("collider global x pos of other: ",body.get_node("CollisionShape3D").global_position.x)
	print("collider global x pos of self: ",$Area3D.get_node("CollisionShape3D").global_position.x)
	
	print("collider size of other: ",body.get_node("CollisionShape3D").shape.size)
	print("collider size of self: ",$Area3D.get_node("CollisionShape3D").shape.size)
```


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[collider_test_godot.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18832984/collider_test_godot.zip)

Edit: same problem in 2D, just tested
Edit2: if i move the collider directly instead of moving the character body, it works as expected
